description: The replication data and analysis code for the published study has been published on dryad https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.cc2fqz6gt . Observational data on births and deaths from the longterm study on wild Assamese macaques in their natural habitat collected by the Phu Khieo Macaque Project run by University of Göttingen and the Deutsches Primatenzentrum Göttingen
